G0.reason: Baseline captured; 1128 path dispositions require source-level review rather than automatic path classification.

G1A.reason: Independent Solid shell, descriptor registry, extension client, authenticated host, scoped SSE, native database graph and layout CAS have executable coverage. This is not the complete native host surface.

G1B.reason: Native Session facade, owned Location runner, native coordinator/Location-map integration, private request/compaction and managed replay have executable coverage with shared service identities. Legacy/HTTP entrypoint coverage, child ownership and original fork transfer/migration compatibility remain incomplete. Full parity stays blocked.

removalRule: Retain integrated packages until all parity, migration and host gates pass. A proof shell or clean submodule is not permission to delete current functionality.
